title: E-mail log
subtitle: Every invitation and notification e-mail this organisation sent: when it was queued, whether it went out, and what the mail provider reported back.
footnote: Sent means the e-mail provider accepted the message. Delivered, bounced and spam reports come from the provider's webhook; opens are recorded once. Notification e-mails are kept 90 days.
emptyHint: Invitations and e-mail notifications appear here as soon as they are queued.

events.delivered: Delivered to the recipient's mail server
events.complained: Marked as spam by the recipient
events.provider_failed: The provider could not send it

reasons.invitation_revoked: The invitation was revoked before the e-mail went out.
reasons.invitation_accepted: The invitation was accepted (with the copied link) before the e-mail went out.
reasons.recipient_not_member: The recipient is no longer a member of the organisation.
reasons.invalid_recipient_address: The recipient has no valid e-mail address.

banner.stalledTitle_one: {{count}} e-mail has been waiting for more than {{minutes}} minutes
banner.stalledTitle_other: {{count}} e-mails have been waiting for more than {{minutes}} minutes
banner.stalled: The oldest was queued {{since}}. No worker is sending e-mails: check that the worker is running and was deployed together with the API. Invitation links can still be copied and shared meanwhile.
banner.console_one: {{count}} e-mail was not sent: the server has no e-mail provider configured (EMAIL_PROVIDER on the worker).
banner.console_other: {{count}} e-mails in the last 7 days were not sent: the server has no e-mail provider configured (EMAIL_PROVIDER on the worker).

detail.title: E-mail
detail.awaitingProvider: No delivery report from the provider yet. Delivery, bounce and spam reports appear here once the provider's webhook is connected.
